title: On Reserving the best room for visitors
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：reserve　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reserve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the cook ① reserved the best room for visitors with great care, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② reserves the best room for visitors on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reserve the best room for visitors at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reserved the best room for visitors before — a line in the menu for September 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reserving the best room for visitors with great care, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reserve two seats on the morning coach on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reserve two seats on the morning coach at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ reserves two seats on the morning coach with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reserved the best room for visitors again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reserve the best room for visitors, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody reserves the best room for visitors on the same day again and somebody must reserve the best room for visitors with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 保留（一般过去式 reserved the best room for visitors：1952 年厨子头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 保留（一般现在 reserves the best room for visitors：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 保留（不定式 to reserve the best room for visitors：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 保留（过去完成时 had reserved the best room for visitors：1946 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 保留（动名词 reserving the best room for visitors 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 预订（reserve two seats on the morning coach：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去预订在早班车上订了两个位子）
G. v. 预订（reserve two seats on the morning coach：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 保留（后段两处：新来的客人照例 reserves two seats on the morning coach，而母亲又一次 reserved the best room for visitors）

answers.why: reserve 意为“保留”，1952 年厨子小心翼翼地保留把最好的一间屋留给客人，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reserved。
reserve 意为“保留”，自那以后厨子当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reserves。
reserve 意为“保留”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯保留把最好的一间屋留给客人”，此处为不定式 to reserve the best room for visitors。
reserve 意为“保留”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人保留过，故用过去完成时 had reserved。
reserve 意为“保留”，厨子说“保留把最好的一间屋留给客人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reserving the best room for visitors 作主语。
reserve 意为“预订”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去预订在早班车上订了两个位子”，should ever 之后用原形 reserve two seats on the morning coach。
reserve 意为“预订”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻预订在早班车上订了两个位子（reserve two seats on the morning coach at once），以后再也不要提起。
reserve 意为“保留”，新来的客人每个日子都照例预订在早班车上订了两个位子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reserves。
reserve 意为“保留”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地保留把最好的一间屋留给客人，用一般过去式 reserved 叙述。
reserve 意为“保留”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要保留把最好的一间屋留给客人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reserve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the cook reserved the best room for visitors with great care, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook reserves the best room for visitors on the same day whenever the canteen asks.
Reserving the best room for visitors with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reserve two seats on the morning coach on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen reserves two seats on the morning coach with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reserved the best room for visitors again, and the canteen remembered that half.
